                                     <div class="mainParsys parsys"><div class="text baseComponent parbase section"><p>As a financial services CISO, it’s essential to know that threat actors disproportionately target the financial service industry because its organizations store, transmit and process high volumes of monetizable sensitive information. An effective <a href="https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/unit42/transform/incident-response-plan-development-review" data-page-track="true" data-page-track-value="resources:key-considerations-building-ir-plan-for-financial-services: section:key considerations: building an incident response plan for financial services">incident response (IR) plan</a> can be the difference between business disruption and devastation.</p>
<p>This webinar gives financial industry stakeholders powerful insights outlining how to align IR planning to match threat actors' tactics, techniques, and procedures. Watch now for an insider perspective on the required components of an incident response plan, including:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Pitfalls and keys to success in building an IR plan.</p>
</li>
<li><p>Alignment with regulatory requirements (GLBA, SOX, PCI DSS, etc.).</p>
</li>
<li><p>Cyber insurance to help reduce the financial burden of a security incident.</p>
</li>
<li><p>A guide to putting your IR plan into action.</p>
</li>
<li><p>Best practices for reporting, recovering, and resetting your IR plan.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>Watch the webinar now to start building or improving your IR plan and reduce the impact of cyberattacks on your organization.</p>
<p> </p>

Watch Now Prisma AIRS AI Gateway is now generally available Products Solutions Services Industries Partners Resources us Accounts & Support Demos and Trials Search All Tech Docs Webinar Key Considerations: Building an Incident Response Plan for Financial Services Aug 09, 2023 As a financial services CISO, it’s essential to know that threat actors disproportionately target the financial service industry because its organizations store, transmit and process high volumes of monetizable sensitive information. An effective incident response (IR) plan can be the difference between business disruption and devastation. This webinar gives financial industry stakeholders powerful insights outlining how to align IR planning to match threat actors' tactics, techniques, and procedures. Watch now for an insider perspective on the required components of an incident response plan, including: Pitfalls and keys to success in building an IR plan. Alignment with regulatory requirements (GLBA, SOX, PCI DSS, etc.). Cyber insurance to help reduce the financial burden of a security incident. A guide to putting your IR plan into action. Best practices for reporting, recovering, and resetting your IR plan. Watch the webinar now to start building or improving your IR plan and reduce the impact of cyberattacks on your organization.   Related Resources Access a wealth of educational materials, such as datasheets, whitepapers, critical threat reports, informative cybersecurity topics, and top research analyst reports See all resources Get the latest news, invites to events, and threat alerts Enter your email now to subscribe!     function maskEmailAddress(emailAddress) {
      function mask(str) {
        var strLen = str.length;
        if (strLen > 4) {
          return str.substr(0, 1) + str.substr(1, strLen - 1).replace(/\w/g, "*") + str.substr(-1, 1);
        }
        return str.replace(/\w/g, "*");
      }
      return emailAddress.replace(/([\w.]+)@([\w.]+)(\.[\w.]+)/g, function (m, p1, p2, p3) {
        return mask(p1) + "@" + mask(p2) + p3;
      });

      return emailAddress;
    }
